# 3GPP TS 25.331 — UMTS RRC Protocol Specification

## What It Specifies
The RRC protocol for UTRAN (WCDMA/HSPA), operating on the Uu interface between UE and Node B/RNC. Defines the signaling layer responsible for all control-plane radio bearer management in 3G networks. This is the UMTS equivalent of 36.331 (LTE) and 38.331 (NR).

## Key Procedures Defined
- **RRC Connection establishment/release** — state machine governing Idle, Cell_DCH, Cell_FACH, Cell_PCH, URA_PCH transitions
- **System Information broadcast** — MIB/SIB scheduling and content (SIB1–SIB18+), cell selection/reselection parameters
- **Radio Bearer setup/reconfiguration/release** — mapping RBs to transport channels (DCH, RACH, FACH, HS-DSCH, E-DCH)
- **Measurement and reporting** — intra/inter-frequency, inter-RAT (GSM, LTE) handover triggers, event-based reporting (1A–1J, 2A–2F, 3A, 4A, 6A, etc.)
- **Handover procedures** — hard handover, SRNS relocation, inter-RAT HO to/from LTE
- **Security procedures** — integrity protection and ciphering activation via RRC signaling
- **Paging** and RRC state transitions

## Key Interfaces
Primarily **Uu** (UE↔UTRAN). RRC messages carried over RLC/MAC on logical channels. Iur and Iu impacts are indirect but relevant for SRNS relocation procedures.

## When a RAN Engineer Uses It
- Troubleshooting RRC setup failures, call drops, or HO failures in UMTS/HSPA networks
- Decoding RNC protocol logs or UE traces against message IEs
- Configuring SIB parameters (cell reselection, UE timers T300/T301/T313

# 3GPP TS 36.300 — E-UTRA and E-UTRAN Overall Description

## What It Specifies
The architectural reference document for LTE RAN. Defines the overall E-UTRAN architecture, functional split between nodes, and the protocols and procedures that bind the system together. It's the entry point before diving into detailed procedure specs (36.304, 36.321, 36.331, etc.).

## Key Interfaces Defined
- **X2**: eNB-to-eNB interface — handover signaling, load management, interference coordination (eICIC)
- **S1-MME**: eNB-to-MME control plane (S1AP)
- **S1-U**: eNB-to-S-GW user plane (GTP-U)
- **LTE-Uu**: Air interface between UE and eNB

## Key Procedures Specified (at architecture level)
- Intra/inter-frequency and inter-RAT handover flows
- S1 and X2 setup and reset procedures
- Paging and cell search architecture
- RRC states (RRC_IDLE, RRC_CONNECTED) and state transitions
- MBMS architecture and bearer handling
- Carrier aggregation and dual connectivity (eNB-MeNB/SeNB split)
- SON functions: ANR, MLB, MRO
- Security architecture (AS/NAS separation)

## When a RAN Engineer Uses It
- **Network design**: Understanding functional splits when planning X2 mesh topology or S1 flex configurations
- **Integration**: Validating eNB interconnect setup (X2/S1 establishment sequences)
- **Dual connectivity / ENDC baseline**: Understanding MeNB/SeNB architecture before referencing 37.340
- **Troubleshooting**: Confirming expected handover trigger logic or paging flow architecture before tracing at the procedure level
- **Spec navigation**: Identifying which detailed spec owns a specific procedure

**Bottom line**: Read this first. It's the map before the territory.

# 3GPP TS 38.331 — NR Radio Resource Control (RRC)

## What It Specifies
The complete RRC protocol for NR: message syntax (ASN.1), signaling procedures, and state machine governing UE-gNB control-plane interaction over the Uu interface. Covers both SA and NSA (EN-DC, NE-DC, NGEN-DC) configurations.

## Key Procedures Defined
- **RRC state transitions**: RRC_IDLE → RRC_INACTIVE → RRC_CONNECTED, including suspend/resume
- **Connection establishment/reconfiguration**: `RRCSetup`, `RRCReconfiguration`, `RRCReestablishment` including MCG/SCG failure handling
- **Measurement configuration and reporting**: Event-triggered (A1–A6, B1–B2) and periodic; RSRP/RSRQ/SINR report configs, layer-3 filtering
- **Handover**: intra/inter-frequency, inter-RAT, CHO (Conditional HO), DAPS HO
- **Beamforming and BM**: SSB/CSI-RS based beam reporting, L1/L3 measurement linkage
- **RAN-based paging and notification areas** (RNA/RNAU) for RRC_INACTIVE
- **Secondary cell/node addition and modification**: SgNB/SCG addition via `RRCReconfiguration` carrying `SCG-Config`
- **SIB broadcast**: SIB1–SIB20+ scheduling and content definitions
- **NTN-specific extensions** (Rel-17/18): TA pre-compensation, ephemeris delivery

## Key Interfaces
Primarily **Uu** (UE↔gNB). RRC containers also carried transparently over **Xn** (XnAP) and **X2** (X2AP) during HO/SCG procedures, and over **N2** (NGAP) via NAS transport.
